strings.name: Ronaldinho
strings.summary: Developed at Grêmio, Ronaldinho became known for dribbling, free kicks and imaginative passing. He won the 2002 World Cup with Brazil, the Ballon d’Or and Champions League at Barcelona, and later the Copa Libertadores. He announced retirement in 2018 and was detained in Paraguay over false passports in 2020. He joined Ravenna in 2026; his announced comeback match had not occurred by cutoff.
strings.coverageNote: Selected milestones verifiable through November 13, 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: A World Cup and Ballon d’Or winner whose technical style deeply influenced fans and young players worldwide.
